name: Q-Linq
detailed_description:
Q-Linq: A VR Adventure Where Skill Meets Story

Dive into "Q-Linq," a VR innovation blending skill and narrative in a new twist on the bubble-pop, match-3 genre. Engage in physics-driven levels where quick thinking, precision aim, and strategic insight are key. This isn't just a game; it's a skill-based journey that reinvents a beloved classic.

The Quantum Academy Awaits

As a cadet at the Quantum Academy, your task is to power quantum engines. Master the art of shooting and matching colored spheres against a rotating quantum core. Each level challenges you to create charged explosions with meticulous aim and clever tactics.

A Rich, Dynamic Storyline

"Q-Linq" is more than a puzzle game. It's also a dramatic story of growth, conflict, betrayal, and redemption. Follow the intertwined destinies of two protagonists, exploring not just the mechanics of powering starships but also the complex web of their lives and those they meet along the way.

Art and Sound Powered by AI

Designed with the casual VR gamer in mind, "Q-Linq" boasts a unique art style, featuring vibrant talking portraits, all created, animated, and voiced by AI under the guidance of a solo developer. The AI-generated music and voice acting enhance the immersion, breaking new ground for indie VR development.

Endless Gameplay

With its procedurally generated levels, "Q-Linq" offers limitless replay-ability. In addition to a campaign, you will also enjoy the Arcade Mode for more challenges and bubble-popping fun.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 or AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR, Requires Motion Controllers, Seated/Stationary
